entries.fd32998f3d56db7e: This business develops and manufactures functional resin composite materials based on thermosetting and thermoplastic resins tailored to applications and required characteristics, and manufactures and sells functional precision molded products using these materials. Precision molded products are used in mechanical components holding autofocus sensors in digital cameras, ink supply components in inkjet printers, mechanical components in barcode reader devices, and encoder components in precision dimension measuring instruments. It also sells the Pulse Injector® system for research and development and for evaluation and analysis. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,063 million.
